question: For open:gate1-original-cycle-signed-global-intersections, does one declared m=2 diagonal scale-scalar infinity ray supply a uniform good-action boundary component needed by the mixed-end census, while a sign-flipped ray acts as a false-signal control and the source cycle and signed global intersection vector remain null?
primary_obstacle: One explicitly tested scale-scalar projective direction in the still-open Gate-1 mixed-end boundary census.

graph_route_review.missing_typed_object: One declared mixed-infinity action-decay candidate record, including its sign and scope, for the incomplete Gate-1 end census.
graph_route_review.bounded_output: An exact uniform real-action bound for one positive diagonal mixed tail plus direct original-action samples.
graph_route_review.false_signal_control: The same scalar/lapse correlation with x=-s must have the opposite leading sign and a uniform bad-action bound.
graph_route_review.human_review_basis: The user explicitly requested continuation of the next realistic task; this design keeps that work on the retrieved current Gate-1 blocker.

ragnarok_boundary.distinct_question: This one-ray mixed-infinity certificate does not rerun or repair Phase 39 or the preceding scale-tail runner and does not compute a numbered descendant.

upstream_evidence.role: Frozen equal-endpoint m=2 action, boundary values and finite nonzero-lapse envelope.
Durable statement that all scale, scalar and mixed ends and the global cycle remain open.
General-q action conventions and the preceding compact-q scale-only selection family.
Executed compact-q scale-tail result whose scalar-infinity and mixed-end outputs remain null.
Human-readable boundary separating compact-q scale ends from untested mixed infinity.

primary_sources.title: Analytic Continuation Of Chern-Simons Theory
primary_sources.role: Relative good-end language only. With I=-S_2, the declared tail must satisfy Re(S_2) tending uniformly to positive infinity. This source does not supply the model, tail, full relative pair, thimble basis or original cycle.

primary_sources.title: Periods for rank 1 irregular singular connections on surfaces
primary_sources.role: Boundary comparator only. Its rapid-decay homology requires compactification, a normal-crossing divisor and a good meromorphic irregular connection, none of which is constructed here.

declared_conventions.model: equal-endpoint two-segment midpoint Starobinsky configuration action with h=1/2
declared_conventions.phase_cancellation: q^2/T=s^2/rho is exactly positive real on both tails
declared_conventions.good_action_end: Re(S_2) tends uniformly to positive infinity along the declared positive diagonal tail
declared_conventions.bad_action_end: Re(S_2) tends uniformly to negative infinity along the declared sign-flipped control
declared_conventions.potential_bound: Since phi_boundary>1, cos(psi/2)>=1/sqrt(2), sqrt(2/3)>4/5 and exp(4/5)>2, |exp(-sqrt(2/3)*Phi)|<1/2 and |V(Phi)|<27/16.
declared_conventions.newton_polyhedron_exclusion: The Starobinsky exponential makes the phase non-polynomial in the original scalar coordinate; no complex cover, logarithmic branch, toric compactification or divisor data are supplied, so Newton-polyhedron criteria are not invoked.
selection_family: one correlated positive diagonal x=s and q=s*exp(i*psi/2)
one sign-flipped x=-s false-signal control with the same q and T
the prior finite nonzero-lapse envelope only
action decay only, without amplitude, measure, determinant or connector data
no other scale-scalar ratio, scalar phase, coordinate face, lapse endpoint, source cycle or global intersection

controls: Rebuild the exact two-element action before substituting either mixed ray.
Prove q^2/T=s^2/rho exactly and extract the positive and sign-flipped s^5 coefficients without a fitted asymptotic.
Prove the uniform Starobinsky potential modulus bound |V|<27/16 on the full declared lapse-phase range.
Bound every non-scalar-kinetic term directly and prove Re(S_2)>0 for all s>=48 on the positive diagonal tail.
Independently prove Re(S_2)<0 for all s>=36 on the sign-flipped control, preventing a phase-cancellation sign bug from passing unnoticed.
Evaluate the original two-element complex action, not the extracted leading polynomial, at 54 predeclared points.
Check conjugation symmetry between psi and -psi and convergence to both opposite exact leading coefficients.
Keep attachment, amplitude/measure convergence, all other ends, the complete census, source/relative cycle, global vector and every physical output null.

decision_table.condition: the declared positive diagonal has a uniform positive exact bound, its sign-flipped control has a uniform negative exact bound, and both original-action numerical controls converge to the corresponding leading coefficients
the positive diagonal bound is nonpositive or its direct-action sequence approaches a nonpositive leading coefficient
the exact bounds and original-action controls disagree or the sign-flipped control does not detect the opposite sign
